description_en: Queries the forgot password policy of a specified EIAM instance
description_zh: 查询指定EIAM实例下忘记密码策略
name: GetForgetPasswordConfiguration

AuthenticationChannels.description_en: The list of authentication channels for forgot password. This parameter is required when ForgetPasswordStatus is set to enabled. Valid values: email, sms (SMS), totp (OTP), and web_authn (WebAuthn)
AuthenticationChannels.description_zh: 忘记密码认证渠道列表。当forgetPasswordStatus取值为enabled时必传。枚举取值:email(邮件)、sms(短信)、totp(OTP动态口令)、web_authn(WebAuthn)

items.description_en: The authentication channel for forgot password. This parameter is required when ForgetPasswordStatus is set to enabled. Valid values: email, sms (SMS), totp (OTP), and web_authn (WebAuthn)
items.description_zh: 忘记密码认证渠道。当forgetPasswordStatus取值为enabled时必传。枚举取值:email(邮件)、sms(短信)、totp(OTP动态口令)、web_authn(WebAuthn)

AuthenticationChannels.title_en: 忘记密码认证渠道。当forgetPasswordStatus取值为enabled时必传。枚举取值:email(邮件)、sms(短信)
AuthenticationChannels.title_zh: 忘记密码认证渠道。当forgetPasswordStatus取值为enabled时必传。枚举取值:email(邮件)、sms(短信)

Enable.description_en: Indicates whether the forgot password feature is enabled. This parameter is deprecated. Use the ForgetPasswordStatus parameter instead
Enable.description_zh: 是否开启忘记密码，已废弃，参考使用forgetPasswordStatus参数

EnableEmail.description_en: Indicates whether email is enabled as an authentication method for forgot password. This parameter is deprecated. Use the AuthenticationChannels parameter instead
EnableEmail.description_zh: 是否开启邮件做为忘记密码的认证方法，已废弃，请参考使用authenticationChannels
EnableEmail.title_en: 是否开启邮件做为忘记密码的认证方法
EnableEmail.title_zh: 是否开启邮件做为忘记密码的认证方法

EnableSms.description_en: Indicates whether SMS is enabled as an authentication method for forgot password. This parameter is deprecated. Use the AuthenticationChannels parameter instead
EnableSms.description_zh: 表示是否开启SMS做为忘记密码的认证方法，已废弃，请参考使用authenticationChannels
EnableSms.title_en: 是否开启SMS做为忘记密码的认证方法
EnableSms.title_zh: 是否开启SMS做为忘记密码的认证方法

ForgetPasswordStatus.description_en: The status of the forgot password configuration. Valid values: enabled and disabled
ForgetPasswordStatus.description_zh: 忘记密码配置状态。枚举取值:enabled(开启)、disabled(禁用)
ForgetPasswordStatus.title_en: 忘记密码配置状态。枚举取值:enabled(开启)、disabled(禁用)
ForgetPasswordStatus.title_zh: 忘记密码配置状态。枚举取值:enabled(开启)、disabled(禁用)
